## Doctoral student organizations and clubs {#social-organizations}

::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

Contributions are welcome on doctoral student organizations, interest groups, activity channels, and participation. People familiar with each organization should provide its name, how to join, and the relevant dates.

:::

## Peer connections and mutual support {#social-peer-support}

::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

This section needs first-hand experience of meeting students across schools, reading groups, and peer support. Share private group links or personal contact details only with permission.

:::

## Cross-cultural exchange {#social-cross-cultural}

::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

Contributions are welcome on international and local student connections, language exchange, and cross-cultural activities. A verified list of organizations or joining instructions has not yet been compiled.

:::

## Contribute experience {#social-overview-contribute}

::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

This is a topic outline, not a completed guide. Use “Add or correct content” below or read [Contributions and corrections](../about/contributing.qmd#xp-guide-contributing) to share your experience.

:::
